Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the tabletop this week — super helpful. After the session our SecOps team asked us to formally request two things so we can close our internal audit item: 1) a copy of Redwood's IR runbook (high-level; redacted where necessary) and 2) confirmation that the telemetry collected during the 2026-05-10 spike is preserved and available for escrow review.

Can Redwood 1) provide the runbook PDF for review (we don't need low-level secrets), and 2) provide an export manifest and temporary escrow access instructions so our third-party ProcureCloud auditor can pull logs/telemetry. We can coordinate a limited access window.

Attaching what our auditor needs as a checklist. If it's easier, loop in whoever owns evidence escrow on your side and we'll get a DocuSign access agreement in place.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our SOC2 audit window is next month.

Thanks,
Alex Harris
Head of Security
Sunset Payments

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for joining the tabletop. We can support both items. Quick summary / next steps below:

1) IR runbook: attached is a redacted PDF (ir-runbook-v2.pdf). It contains incident roles, escalation matrix, and our evidence preservation checklist. Redactions: internal IPs and vendor keys removed. If you need additional context on any step, we can schedule a short walkthrough.

2) Telemetry preservation & escrow: Naomi will coordinate a controlled export window for ProcureCloud. We'll produce a manifest (preserved-telemetry-manifest.csv) that lists S3 object keys, time ranges, and hashing info. ProcureCloud will need temporary S3 read-only credentials scoped to the export objects and an NDA/DocuSign acceptance from Sunset.

Action owners:
- Naomi: produce manifest + generate temporary creds (ETA 24 hours)
- Jonas: sanity-check logs and provide a short summary of what was preserved (rolling token traces, request/response metadata)
- Laura: review the DocuSign language for access agreement and loop legal if there are unusual indemnity asks

I'll also share a short instruction doc for evidence escrow (evidence-escrow-instructions.docx) and a Drive link to the sanitized extracts.

We're copying ProcureCloud to keep them in the loop.

—Marissa
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ir-runbook-v2.pdf, evidence-escrow-instructions.docx
